conventions: New top-level helpers should match the existing style of check_site/main (no type hints); leave type-hinted functions like badge_style/is_denied as the exception, not the pattern
Ad-hoc progress/status prints use a two-space indent prefix, e.g. print(f"  Failed: {e}"), matching check_site's existing exception logging

Dict literals use double-quoted keys (e.g. {"site": site["name"]}); f-strings that need to subscript a dict use single quotes inside (e.g. f"Checking {site['name']}...") since the f-string itself is double-quoted
